coverage_notes: CMS Public Notices was checked first via a targeted CMS-domain query, but the CMS Public Notices page itself was not retrievable in this run, leaving the official-notice leg partially degraded. Exactly 12 additional targeted searches were then completed across hospital/ED/maternity, behavioral health, dialysis, oncology, primary care, rural/emergency service loss, ambulance/air-medical, CMS CLIA risk, restoration/reopening, and U.S. territories. No new qualifying U.S. or territory healthcare-access change was identified in the bounded hourly window. A Maine maternity-access feature published during the window described a Lincoln Hospital labor-and-delivery closure effective 2026-12-18 that had already been announced and debated previously, so it was excluded as not a new development. A Brattleboro birthing-center story described a prior decision to keep the service open rather than a newly effective restoration in this window. Historical, non-U.S., proposal-only, ownership-only, unsupported, and duplicate items were excluded.
